india.one_line: SEBI plans AI capital market guidelines, Bharat Semi secures seed funding, and India joins a US-led supply chain accord.

themes.title: SEBI to issue AI guidelines for capital markets
themes.text: SEBI chairman Tuhin Kanta Pandey announced that the regulator will soon release guidelines requiring market firms to disclose AI usage and maintain human oversight for critical decisions.

stories.headline: SEBI to issue guidelines for AI use and human oversight in capital markets
Sebi to issue AI usage guidelines for capital markets focusing on investor protection

themes.title: Indian chip startup raises $24 million
themes.text: Indian semiconductor startup Bharat Semi raised $24 million in seed funding to develop AI-enabled image sensors, targeting commercial production by 2027.

stories.headline: Indian chip startup Bharat Semi lands $24M seed round for AI sensors

themes.title: India joins allied AI supply chain accord
themes.text: India joined the US, Japan, and the UK in agreeing to create a joint list of AI technologies and supply chains to protect against China.

stories.headline: US and allies agree to create joint list to protect AI supply chains from China
